## About

I am a Postdoctoral Researcher at the **Scuola Superiore Meridionale (SSM)** in Naples, Italy.

My research lies at the intersection of **stochastic control, optimization, applied probability, and decision-making under uncertainty**, with particular interests in distributionally robust optimization, Markov jump systems, stochastic games, and mathematical finance.
